description: This Java source file defines the GetPrimaryKeysOperation class, which retrieves primary key metadata for a specified table in Hive, including schema definitions, method implementations for executing the operation, and handling result sets.

classes.name: GetPrimaryKeysOperation
classes.description: Class that performs retrieval of primary key metadata for a specific table in Hive, including schema definition and result set handling.

methods.name: runInternal
methods.description: Executes the operation to fetch primary keys from the metastore and populates the result set.

methods.name: getResultSetSchema
methods.description: Returns the schema of the result set as a TTableSchema object.

methods.name: getNextRowSet
methods.description: Provides the next set of rows from the result set based on fetch orientation and max rows.
